title: Canonical fixed-scalar coordinates for a finite system evaluation
statement: For a prime l, a finite extension E of Q_l, a system operation package o of [def-sf-integral-system-operations] and m≥0, define input(W,M) to be the canonical inverse coefficient realization of ev_m(M). Define push and shriek coordinates by composing the recorded o evaluation with the inverse coefficient counit and the specified fixed-scalar direct/open comparison. Define fixedPush and fixedShriek by inverse coefficient realization followed by its inverse unit. Define support by supportEvaluation, the inverse coefficient counit and sfIntrinsicCompactSupportComparison. These are actual composites of the specified isomorphisms, with no existence choices. The support coordinate equals the direct coordinate followed by the realized fixed open coordinate; the direct coordinates obey naturality.

from.place: Proof, paragraph beginning "For an admissible exceptional adjoint", sentence "the projection transformation of [def-exchange-projection] is a composite of precisely these tensor and counit maps, hence is equivariant as well": the Frobenius-transported compactification differs from the chosen one, so the two projection composites must be compared through the refinement comparison.
